proposed_capability: Add a minimal, bounded, exact-build prior-experience index that persists a new semantic outcome once, yields an unchanged index on familiar experiences, and gives advisory recall of prior game observations without restarting Sims or claiming that an already-observed outcome completed the current dialog.
operator_correction: The vanilla and BetterInstincts-mod sessions have already been exercised; do not restart or reproduce the Video Gaming Yes/No research to reconstruct remembered prior experience. Reuse prior receipts by exact scenario. Persist only a genuinely new experience; repeated encounters should be read-only.
player_save_control_impact: No game launch, save/Mods mutation, camera movement, automatic game input, continuous observer, identity capture or player input listening; store only sanitized exact patch/experience outcome references under an explicit repo-ignored dist path. Historical recall never grants permission to click or proves the currently open dialog was answered.
expected_outcome: On a new prior-receipt experience, write once with bounded exact-build context and provenance; on the same repeated encounter or identical fact, return ALREADY_KNOWN without writing; on context mismatch return MISS; on contradictory result HOLD without overwriting; on recall return advisory prior result with current_event_complete=false and no execution permission.
negative_tests: same result with different capture reference creates no second record
same known record performs no file write and preserves original bytes and mtime
changed game build or installation digest cannot reuse an outcome
conflicting result cannot overwrite earlier evidence
unverified or unknown proof level is rejected
past YES/NO observations are not interpreted as completion of the presently open dialog
no private sim identity, save path, raw screenshot or input logs in the experience payload
no automatic game boot, game control, player queue action or model training
rollback_path: Drop the new optional library/CLI on its isolated feature branch; existing preference, judgment learning and chance-event memo owners are unchanged and game/save state remains intact.
unresolved_unknowns: Current Windows-local raw receipts and mod profile digests are not accessible through GitHub; the local operator/agent must populate new sanitized records from already completed trials without replay.
Native preference actor and household readback remains independently owned by stacked PR #263 and Windows observer.
